candidates.change_summary: Move the external call to msg.sender.call{value: oCredit}("") before zeroing the caller's credit (introduces reentrancy vulnerability changing post-withdrawAll state).
Do not reset the caller's credit to zero after sending funds (leaves credit[msg.sender] unchanged), so subsequent withdrawAll behaves differently.
Reset the caller's credit to zero before reducing the contract balance (alters state ordering and possible invariant outcomes).
Send funds using transfer instead of low-level call (changes reentrancy behavior and failure semantics).
Send funds using send and require the result, replacing call (changes gas forwarding and failure handling).
Subtract a different amount from balance (use oCredit - 1) before sending, altering resulting contract balance and possibly reverting for small amounts.
